title: Move the head left
statement: Let $\ell>0$, and let $z$ consist of a home cell containing an optional Boolean value and left and right lists of optional Boolean values indexed by $0,\ldots,\ell-1$, each of length at index $j$ at most $2\cdot 2^j$. Suppose the right list at index $0$ has room for one more entry, so its length plus one is at most $2$. The new home cell is the head of the left list at index $0$, interpreted as an optional Boolean value; remove the head of the left list at index $0$ and prepend the old home cell to the right list at index $0$. All other lists remain unchanged.
